A '''Repulsor thresher''' was a thresher equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] that was used primarily in agriculture.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> 

[[Gara Petothel]]'s family had one in their farm in [[New Oldtown]].<ref name="if" />
